Name: Sam HD Portraits by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b]Sam HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b]

[b]Your favorite blond guitarist just got an HD glow-up. 💛[/b]


[b]Bring a little extra charm to your conversations with Sam through detailed, expressive portraits in my signature Hemptress style. This set stays close to his original Stardew Valley design, keeping his recognizable blond hair, playful energy, and sweet smile while giving him a polished new look.[/b]


[b]From everyday chats in Pelican Town to sunny afternoons at the beach, these portraits keep Sam looking like the same lovable musician you fell for.[/b]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Download and install[url=https://smapi.io/] SMAPI[/url], following its installer instructions.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Download[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999] Portraiture[/url] for your game version and extract its folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Inside Mods/Portraiture/Portraits, create a folder called Hemptress.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Extract Sam HD Portraits by Hemptress and place the portrait PNG files directly inside that folder. Keep their filenames unchanged.[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Your standard Sam portrait should be located here:[/b]

[b]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Hemptress/Sam.png[/b]
[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI and talk to Sam.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]While his dialogue box is open, press P until the Hemptress portrait set appears. Portraiture remembers your selection.[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Already using my other portraits? Add Sam’s PNG files to the same portrait-set folder to use them together.[/b]
[b]Optional controls: While dialogue is open, press M to open the portrait selection menu, I to switch portrait display styles, or O to lock/unlock the selected set for that character.[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Portraits not appearing? Check that the download is unzipped and that Sam.png sits directly inside your Hemptress folder, without an extra folder between them.[/b]

[/color]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]✨ Included in this set:[/b]


[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Standard HD portraits featuring Sam’s familiar look with detailed hair, facial features, and expressive eyes.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Matching beach portraits featuring shirtless Sam with his blue necklace.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Multiple expressions to bring personality to your conversations.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Transparent backgrounds for a clean presentation.[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]

[b]Made for farmers who have a soft spot for golden retriever energy, band practice, and one very cute reason to visit the town’s resident guitarist.[/b]
[/color]
